[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String.Basic
import Lean.Data.String.Parser

def implementation (s: String) : String :=
let words := s.split (fun c => c = ' ');
let ordered_words := words.map (fun w => w.data.sortedBy (fun c => c.val.toNat));
let result := ordered_words.join " ";
result
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma sorted_by_map (l : List Char) (f : Char → Nat) :
  List.Sorted Nat.le (l.map f) ↔
  ∀ a b, a ∈ l ∧ b ∈ l ∧ f a ≤ f b →
  a ≤ b :=
by
  split
  intro h a b ha hb
  have h_ab := h a b
  have h_f_a_le_f_b := hb.2
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.exists_mem_iff_exists] at h_ab
  simp only [List.exists_mem_iff_exists] at h_ab
  rcases h_ab with ⟨c, hc, h_ac, h_cb⟩
  simp only [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  have h_ac_le_cb := h_ac ▸ h_cb
  simp only [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  simp only [List.mem_map, List.exists_mem_iff_exists] at h_ab
  rcases h_ab with ⟨d, hd, h_da, h_dd⟩
  simp only [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  have h_da_le_dd := h_da ▸ h_dd
  simp only [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  simp only [Nat.le_refl] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  simp only [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  simp only [Nat.le_antisymm] at h_f_a_le_f_b
  exact h_f_a_le_f_b
[END]
